join-anon-modal.title: Hop on
join-anon-modal.desc: Match into an active bus with the same region and price cap · or start one and wait for riders
join-anon-modal.how-body: The system first looks for an active bus that matches your region and price cap · joins if there is one · starts a new bus otherwise so others can hop on. Pool costs are split by rider count · more riders means a lower share each.
join-anon-modal.error-generic: Couldn't hop on · try again shortly

join-invite-modal.title: Join with an invite code
join-invite-modal.desc: Use a friend's invite code to hop on their bus · share the pool, split the tab
join-invite-modal.alert-body: Codes are case-insensitive · one code is reusable (owners can rotate it any time)
join-invite-modal.error-too-short: Invite codes are at least 4 characters
join-invite-modal.error-not-found: Invalid code, or the bus was dissolved
join-invite-modal.error-full: Bus is full · check with the owner or try another

start-modal.bargain-alert-body: A single-key pull costs more · try at least 2
start-modal.cheap-alert-body-suffix: keys at once · lower per-key cost after splitting
start-modal.auto-refill-desc: When live keys drop below the keep-alive count, the system fetches a round on its own. Off means you decide when to pull.
start-modal.field-watermark: Keep-alive count (refill when live drops below)
